sql:
SELECT
  ps.cluster_label,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ps.posting_key) AS num_listings
FROM posting_skills AS ps
JOIN fct_posting AS fp
  ON ps.posting_key = fp.posting_key
WHERE
  fp.is_open AND fp.remote_us AND fp.is_canonical_listing
GROUP BY
  ps.cluster_label;
